who.value: Taiwan seller setting up a Live show

job.value: Create a Live show with its title, schedule and 7-Eleven pick-up delivery

arrivedFrom.value: A 'Create Live' entry in the seller's tools

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Create Live' with a cover slot, 'Title *', 'Description' and 'Schedule date & time *' make the job plain.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width 'Create Live' button is the only primary and is disabled until required fields are done.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Most fields are clear, but 'Set shipment limit' doesn't say what limit or what happens when it's on.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Waiting Screen' in the description placeholder and 'Shipment grouping' are used without explanation.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Title, schedule and delivery are things the seller decides at setup.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Optional 'Moderators' and 'Set shipment limit' are shown to everyone up front rather than tucked away.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Every field is about setting up this show.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels carry the form; the only prose is two short lines explaining 7-Eleven parcel grouping.
